title: 3dEigsToDT
description: Convert set of DTI eigenvectors and eigenvalues to a diffusion tensor, with optional value-scaling and vector-flipping.

eig_vals.description: Searchable descriptor for finding all three required eigenvalue files. It should list all three eigenvalue files in descending order of magnitude.
eig_vals.title: Eigenvalue Files Descriptor

eig_vecs.description: Searchable descriptor for finding all three required eigenvector files. It should list all three eigenvector files in order matching the eigenvalue files.
eig_vecs.title: Eigenvector Files Descriptor

prefix.description: Prefix for the output file name. It is recommended to include a 'DT' label in it.
prefix.title: Output File Prefix

mask.description: Optional mask within which to calculate uncertainty. If not provided, the data should be masked already.
mask.title: Mask File

flip_x.description: Change sign of the first element of eigenvectors.
flip_x.title: Flip X

flip_y.description: Change sign of the second element of eigenvectors.
flip_y.title: Flip Y

flip_z.description: Change sign of the third element of eigenvectors.
flip_z.title: Flip Z

scale_eigs.description: Rescale the eigenvalues by dividing by a number X > 0.
scale_eigs.title: Scale Eigenvalues
